column7: REVIEW-SERVERGUARD-RECOVERYKEY-1 F4 (acquire race): the SQLite sidecar was opened and then flocked in two calls, so a sidecar unlinked in between left the caller locking a deleted file while an admin command (or a server) held the new one. Acquisition now checks after the flock that the path still names the locked inode and retries, then fails loudly; a filesystem without flock support or inode numbers is refused at start (TestSQLiteExclusive_SidecarUnlinkedBeforeFlock_ServerWins, TestSQLiteAcquire_FlockUnsupported_FailsLoud, TestSQLiteAcquire_NoInodeNumbers_FailsLoud, internal/serverguard/serverguard_sidecar_acquire_race_test.go).
